description: This file defines a PHP class SampleXMLRPCServer extending an XMLRPC server class, implementing methods for retrieving test suite IDs by name and uploading statistics within a TestLink API context.

classes.name: SampleXMLRPCServer
classes.description: An extension of TestlinkXMLRPCServer that implements specific methods for retrieving test suite IDs by name and uploading statistics, with internal methods to handle these operations.

methods.name: getTestSuiteIDByName
methods.description: Handles the request to retrieve a test suite ID based on the provided name, with security checks and validation.

methods.name: uploadStats
methods.description: Uploads statistical data received from the client, logging each key-value pair except for the developer key.
